About_&_Key_Points:
About
CSB Bank (formerly The Catholic Syrian Bank Ltd) is engaged in the business of banking Services ,oldest private sector banks in India with a history of over 98 years, and a strong base in Kerala , Bank focus on SME, retail, and NRI customers.(Source : Company Web-site )
Key Points
Business Segments Q3 FY26
[1]
a) Retail Banking (~55%):
The company offers products like CASA accounts, deposits, loans, forex, credit cards, gold loans, and personal loans.
b) Wholesale Banking (~27%):
It caters to corporate clients, focusing on corporate lending, capital markets, securitization, and supply chain finance.
c) Treasury Management (~15%):
CSB manages statutory reserves, asset-liability, liquidity, investments, trading in fixed-income securities, and foreign exchange operations.
d) SME Banking (~4%):
It includes the Business Banking and Emerging Enterprise segments.
